analyst_note: Zero refuted findings on file for Organogenesis / ReNu ahead of the NCT04636229 Phase 3 topline in knee osteoarthritis. The only adjudicated material was affirmed or unverifiable, indicating no detected honesty signal—neither company-level fraud history nor trial-specific masking of the catalyst program. Registry shows primary endpoint stability with a completion slip, which is common and not itself a tell without accompanying promotional inconsistency. The marketing record is clean going into the print; this does not forecast efficacy, only that no deception pattern is evident.
